entries.00da7649caa624c4: Customers such as printed circuit board and copper-clad laminate manufacturers
entries.4bb10ee548b222cc: A business in which hydraulic equipment manufactured by consolidated subsidiary Hokusei Kogyo Co., Ltd. is sold directly to customers by it. It is not included in the reportable segments, and sales for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥102 million.
entries.4df447f41ff65394: A business in which the company manufactures printed circuit board press equipment, new material press equipment, laminator equipment, and FA and conveying machinery and sells them to customers. Sales to customers in China are made by consolidated subsidiary Kitagawa Seiki Trading (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. Sales for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥6,505 million.
entries.5c0ebf2568364024: An industrial machinery manufacturer that manufactures and sells press equipment, laminator equipment, and conveying machinery used for molding printed circuit boards and new materials.
entries.7bbbb89e46196b0a: Press equipment used for molding copper-clad laminates and multilayer boards. Examples include multilayer printed circuit board molding presses and large vacuum laminating presses. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.85cd70d4781efee1: Hydraulic equipment manufactured by Hokusei Kogyo Co., Ltd. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.b0a20f5eb4116f90: Press equipment used for molding new materials such as composites. Examples include hot presses for high-temperature composite molding, vacuum presses for molding thermoplastic resin sheets, and laminate molding equipment for CFRTP. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.e49a4fb2bdf87002: Equipment used for laminating substrate materials. Examples include multi-stage vacuum laminator equipment. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.fd3012e4c41cfd54: Machines used for conveying within factories. Examples include floor lifts, hydraulic elevators and solid stockers. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
